note: DEFAULT_IGNORE lists .claude/, .codex/ and .agentic-team/ without a leading slash, so they match at any depth. In a repo with golden test fixtures under tests/golden/<harness>/.codex/ (and .claude/, .agentic-team/), 20 tracked fixture files were invisible to sync, and blueprint.json ignore[] can only add paths, so they cannot be planned. Anchoring these defaults (/.claude/ etc.) would fix it.

Step 5 and the schema.md glob table only say to anchor root files (/package.json). A folder rule with just a trailing slash (agents/) also matches same-named folders at any depth: owner rule agents/ matched skills/*/agents/openai.yaml and validate reported a partial overlap. Saying that folder rules need a leading slash too (/agents/) would have prevented it.

Step 8 presents contracts --write as safe because it never overwrites. In a repo whose own tooling treats every entry of a module folder as an item (here skills/<name>/ packages), the new skills/README.md broke the project's test suite (it looked for skills/README.md/SKILL.md). Suggest telling agents to run the project's checks on a copy before writing contracts.
